content.question: Which regularization technique would you choose if you need a highly interpretable model that automatically selects the most important features?
options: L1-regularization (Lasso), because it produces a sparse model with fewer non-zero weights.
L2-regularization (Ridge), because it keeps all features with small weights.
Elastic Net, because it never sets coefficients to zero.
No regularization, because removing features always reduces interpretability.
content.answer: L1-regularization (Lasso), because it produces a sparse model with fewer non-zero weights.
